ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is the outline of a regular hexagon, with one horizontal side of the hexagon at the top; a circular coin is outside the hexagon, exactly tangent to the upper horizontal side, and the center of the coin is marked with a black dot. Reasoning: The coin diameter is 1 cm, so the radius r=0.5 cm. When the coin rolls around the outside of the regular hexagon, the center of the coin always maintains a distance of 0.5 cm from the boundary of the hexagon, therefore the center trajectory is the outer parallel curve obtained by translating the hexagon outward by 0.5 cm. Corresponding to the six sides there are six straight-line segments, each segment length equal to the hexagon side length 1 cm, and the total straight-line length is 6 cm. When passing the six vertices, the center travels circular arcs; the total turning angle around a convex polygon once is 360°, so these arcs together equal a full circle with radius 0.5 cm, and the arc length is 2π(0.5)=π cm. The total path length is 6+π cm.

raw_record.question_text: A coin with diameter $1 \mathrm{~cm}$ rolls around the contour outside of a regular hexagon with sides $1 \mathrm{~cm}$ long, as shown. How long is the path traced by the centre of the coin (in $\mathrm{cm}$ )?

method.method_draft: First read the picture as a circular coin tangent externally to one side of a regular hexagon, so the coin’s centre stays a fixed distance from the hexagon boundary while it rolls around the outside. From the text, take the hexagon side length as 1 cm and the coin diameter as 1 cm, hence radius r=0.5 cm. The centre’s path is the outer parallel curve at distance r from the hexagon: it has six straight portions parallel to the six sides, each of length 1, contributing 6 cm total, plus rounded arcs around the six vertices. Since the regular hexagon is convex, the total turning angle around all vertices is 360 degrees, so the six arcs together form one full circle of radius 0.5, with length 2π(0.5)=π. Add to get 6+π cm.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有一个规则六边形的轮廓，六边形的一条水平边在上方；一个圆形硬币在六边形外侧，正与上方水平边相切，硬币中心用黑点标出。推理：硬币直径为 1 cm，所以半径 r=0.5 cm。硬币绕正六边形外侧滚动时，硬币中心始终与六边形边界保持 0.5 cm 的距离，因此中心轨迹是六边形向外平移 0.5 cm 得到的外平行曲线。沿六条边对应有六段直线，每段长度等于六边形边长 1 cm，总直线长度为 6 cm。经过六个顶点时，中心走圆弧；凸多边形绕一周的总转角是 360°，所以这些圆弧合起来等于一个半径 0.5 cm 的整圆，弧长为 2π(0.5)=π cm。总路径长度为 6+π cm。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses the standard offset-curve/perimeter-plus-full-circle argument for a convex polygon; it separates the path into straight translated sides and vertex arcs.
planner_metadata.image_role: Identify that the coin rolls externally around the contour of a regular hexagon and that the centre traces a curve parallel to the hexagon sides with rounded joins at vertices.
planner_metadata.text_role: Provides the numerical side length of the hexagon, 1 cm, and the coin diameter, 1 cm, so the radius is 0.5 cm.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the fact that the outer parallel curve of a convex polygon at distance r has length equal to the polygon perimeter plus 2πr, equivalently that the exterior vertex arcs sum to one full circle.
